Measuring Tail Latency at Scale

Short aside summary that should be excluded from voice stats.

Summary

This summary block must be tagged SUMMARY and excluded from voice analysis.

Audience

Engineers operating distributed services.

Why averages mislead

Averages hide outliers. When you measure p50 alone, you miss the slowest requests that users actually feel. We track p99 latency across every region.

  • Measure end to end: capture client-visible timing.
  • Keep histograms bounded so memory stays predictable.
Latency bugs rarely announce themselves — they hide in the tail.
p99 = quantile(samples, 0.99)
